channel.title: Cluster Visibility on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Cluster Visibility on KubeSphere

item.title: View Cluster Visibility
item.description: This section describes how to view which workspaces the cluster has been authorized to. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Cluster Settings View permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Cluster Settings View permissions and enter your cluster. Click Cluster Settings > Cluster Visibility in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Cluster Visibility
item.description: This section describes how to edit cluster visibility. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the Cluster Settings Management permission in the cluster. For more information, see Cluster Members and Cluster Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Cluster Settings Management permissions and enter your cluster. Click Cluster Settings > Cluster Visibility in the left navigation pane.
